## Oculis Publishes Notifications of Transactions by Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities


Oct 8, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.oculis.com/node/10501/pdf)


ZUG, Switzerland, Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The attached notification relates to the vesting and settlement of RSUs previously granted to a member of the Company’s Executive Committee and Board of Directors.
